skill.summary: Fetch onchain reputation profiles via BaseCred SDK (Ethos, Talent Protocol, Farcaster/Neynar). Use when the user wants to check wallet reputation, builder score, creator score, Ethos credibility, or Farcaster account quality for any 0x address. Supports multi-source unified profiles with level derivation and recency tracking.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release - Ethos, Talent Protocol, Farcaster reputation queries
